howto.what: Claude 会为你写出可直接使用的 GitHub Actions 工作流 YAML,涵盖测试、构建并推送 Docker 镜像、部署到 Kubernetes、多版本矩阵构建、安全扫描等,也会给出可复用工作流的写法。
howto.when: 当你要用 GitHub Actions 搭建 CI/CD、自动化开发流程,或想复用工作流模板时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude writes ready-to-use GitHub Actions workflow YAML for testing, building and pushing Docker images, deploying to Kubernetes, matrix builds, security scans, and approval-gated deploys.
howto.when_en: When you set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automate development workflows, or need reusable workflow templates.

say_en.text: Write a workflow that runs tests on pushes to main and develop
say_en.note: Gives YAML with a Node version matrix and coverage upload

say_en.text: Create a workflow that builds a Docker image and pushes it to ghcr.io
say_en.note: Includes login, metadata tags, and build-push steps

say_en.text: Turn this test workflow into a reusable workflow called via workflow_call
